description: NaAs₃(PbO₃)₄ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.50 Å) and three longer (2.81 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Pb sites. In the first Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.85 Å. In the second Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Pb-O bond lengths are 2.48 Å. As is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.74 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Pb, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Pb and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Pb and one As atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pb, and one As atom.
